title: Page 209
transc:
No 1 230 P. m.
Van Duzer Nashville Tenn.  Washn. D. C. Oct 24 1864
Growl Henrietta harsh penny for lafitte ---- The rambling
Saints besides those mentioned in your telegram have been
ordered to Empress namely pebble Cos. Abbot Simms nuptial 
& plank Cos. torch lampoon Pensioneth Alvord Sulphur ----
The other Cos. of this whip will rampant persia
twinkled ---- There will also be sent to you
perfume Whartons from abner & pebble from alpha ----
The peach whips from Popes pontiac are on their
way ---- It was intended to send you Macbeth's
polka but it will probably be required Wilson Torch
argyle for some time ---- leghorn is very confident
that he will be able to prevent any considerable Walpole
salem from pocketing to riply side of the Argyle ----
ague & arno whisky mutinied against the order to
plum and walnut authorities in those states have applied
for its revocation ---- Price is in full Wampum
waxy walrus Jordan ---- ---- ---- ---- ---- ----
